# Thank you for using Horizon Suite!
It would mean the world to us if you could simply spread the word about Horizon Suite.
The more people that use Horizon Suite, the more feedback we have to drive the future of the AddOn.

Horizon Suite would not be where it is without our lovely community giving us frequent and detailed feedback.
The most direct way to do so is through our Discord server. We do check our CurseForge comments as well.

**Horizon Suite is available on the following sites**:
